conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Department, this is Officer Becker. Who am I speaking with today?
Hello, my name is Rahul Sharma. I got a call saying there was something urgent about my taxes, so I am calling back.
Thank you, Mr. Sharma. Yes, this is regarding irregularities found in your federal tax filings for the years 2020 and 2021. Are you aware of any discrepancies with the IRS?
No, I'm not sure what you mean. I thought I did everything correctly. Is there a problem with my taxes?
Unfortunately, yes. Our system shows unpaid back taxes totaling $7,900, plus accrued penalties and late fees. This is a serious federal matter.
Oh my god, that's a lot. I really did not know. I'm very worried. What happens now?

Mr. Sharma, I need you to listen carefully: If this issue is not resolved today, the IRS will initiate legal actions including a lien on your bank account, notification to your employer, and immediate suspension of your Social Security number.
Wait, will this affect my work visa? I can't have any trouble with my status, please.

If you fail to cooperate, the Department of Homeland Security will be informed, which could jeopardize your visa and lead to deportation proceedings. I want to help you avoid this, but you must not delay.
Please, I will do anything. I cannot lose my job or my visa. How do I fix this?

You must settle the outstanding balance immediately to prevent further escalation. The IRS accepts payment via wire transfer, electronic payment apps, or government-approved prepaid gift cards. Which option can you do right now?
I don't know, I have a credit card and some money in my bank. I can maybe do gift cards if that's easier.

Gift cards are the fastest way to clear the pending charges. You must remain on the line with me now and go to a nearby Target or Walmart. Do not discuss this case with anyone, as it is under federal investigation.
Okay, but can I just pay with my credit card directly? I am very scared to do something wrong.

I'm sorry, but credit card payments are not available for enforcement cases like yours. Gift card codes are required for verification and immediate processing. Failing to comply could result in your immediate arrest.
You said arrest? I don't want the police involved. I am going to the store now.
Good. Buy $2,000 worth of Target gift cards first, then call me back with the numbers on the back. After that, we will discuss the remaining balance. Do not hang up or speak to anyone in the store.
Should I get one card for $2,000 or several smaller ones?
Purchase multiple cards with smaller amounts, usually $500 each. Once you have them, stay on the line and read the codes aloud immediately for verification. Time is critical, Mr. Sharma.
Okay, I am at the checkout. Please, please don't call the police. I am doing what you say.
You're cooperating, which is good. Once you provide the codes, I can put your file on hold and protect you from further enforcement measures.
Alright, I have four cards. The numbers are,
Read each code to me slowly and clearly. Any mistake could cause issues with your file.
Thank you. I am verifying these codes with the IRS payment system. Stay on the line and do not speak to anyone if approached.
How long will this take? Am I safe now?
Verification is underway. You still have a balance of $5,900. To prevent escalation, you must repeat this process at another store and obtain additional gift cards.
I don't know if I have enough credit left. Is there another way?
If you do not complete the full payment within the next hour, your case will be handed to law enforcement. This is your only warning, Mr. Sharma.
Okay, okay, I will try to get more cards. Please don't do anything to my visa.
